photos.caption: Fulton Street at Bond Street, looking toward the mall
photos.attribution: Photo: ajay_suresh, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 4.0
photos.brief: Weekday, about 4pm. Stand at the northeast corner of Fulton and Hoyt, face east down the mall. Long exposure so people ghost; storefronts and vendor tables sharp.

photos.caption: 120 Schermerhorn Street, Criminal Court and Central Booking
photos.brief: Wednesday, 10:30 to 11:30am. From the south sidewalk, the public door and the line. Handheld only. Never the sally port, transport, anyone in custody, or badge numbers. Not between 2:30 and 3:30pm (school next door).

photos.caption: The former Abraham and Straus building, Macy's, on Fulton Street
photos.attribution: Photo: Kidfly182, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0
photos.brief: Weekday, about 1pm. The store doors from the sidewalk; count guards and locked cases through the glass for the field note.

photos.caption: Fulton Street at Gallatin Place, the store block between Hoyt Street and Elm Place
photos.attribution: Photo: Tdorante10, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0
photos.brief: Weekday, about 3pm. Tables and the crowd; keep still subjects small or from behind.

photos.caption: The City Point entrance on Fulton Street at Albee Square, the busiest larceny point in the circle
photos.attribution: Photo: ajay_suresh, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 4.0
photos.brief: Weekday, about 4pm. The plaza and escalators from public ground; no interiors.

photos.caption: Livingston Street, one block south, same hour
photos.brief: Same afternoon as the mall shots, within the hour. A quiet frame at the same exposure.

photos.caption: Hoyt-Schermerhorn station entrance on Schermerhorn Street
photos.attribution: Photo: Sashimi-b, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 4.0
photos.brief: Two frames: about 8:30am and about 10pm. Entrance and mezzanine only, handheld.

photos.caption: DeKalb Avenue station entrance at Fleet Street and Flatbush Avenue Extension
photos.attribution: Photo: Harrison Leong, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0
photos.brief: Day and night pair. Photograph the space, never people living in it or their belongings.

photos.caption: Looking east across Boerum Place at the Fulton Street Mall
photos.attribution: Photo: David Shankbone; cropped by Beyond My Ken (talk) 00:50, 14 January 2011 (UTC), Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 2.5
photos.brief: Closing frame, late afternoon, looking up Hoyt toward Fulton.
